title: From the creator of Redis; run LLM locally with ds4
summary: DwarfStar (ds4) is a project by Salvatore Sanfilippo, the creator of Redis, for running large language models locally. Shared on Hacker News, it drew significant attention (266 points, 69 comments) as a lightweight, self-hosted LLM inference tool, reflecting growing interest in local, privacy-preserving AI deployment outside of cloud APIs.
